title: Product Designer
description:

THIS IS A TEST ACCOUNT.

At Tablespace Games, we seek to harness the boundless energy and imagination of our players. Our mission is to create entertainment that inspires creativity, sparks passion, forges friendships, and fosters communities around the globe. We're a dynamic, innovative game development studio specializing in multiplayer experiences that bring people together.

As a small but rapidly growing startup, we're committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in online gaming while maintaining a fun, collaborative work environment. Our team is passionate about crafting immersive, engaging experiences that resonate with players worldwide. We believe in the power of games to connect people, inspire creativity, and create lasting memories.

Every team member plays a crucial role in shaping our games and our company culture. We value diversity, creativity, and a player-first mindset in everything we do. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the gaming industry and create experiences that truly matter to our global community of players.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Acme Games, you'll own the product from thought to finish. You'll be involved in every step of the product process from brainstorming broad ideas to ensuring that the final design is true to the mockups. As a designer at Ladder you'll have influence over the brand and product, will have the opportunity to be a cross-functional partner and will be expected to be a great communicator in taking product ideas across the finish line.

Qualified candidates will have experience owning and leading projects to scale, are detail oriented and can uphold high quality visuals. Above all, this role will expect you to have an understanding of design systems, bold innovation, problem solving skills, creativity, and an optimistic attitude.

About You:

  • You have 2+ years of experience preferably in product design

  • You collaborate cross-functionally with our engineering and product team to develop and expand our product

  • You have experience in designing on multiple platforms (iOS, Android, Mobile Web, Desktop, etc.)

  • You have excellent communication and written skills

  • You are highly proficient in Figma and other design tools

  • You are highly proficient in interactive prototyping tools (Principle, Invision Studio, Protopie, etc.)

  • You demonstrate excellency in design craft

  • You have the ability to work with a low-ego, collaborative, cross-functional team

  • You are excited about working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment

Bonus points:

  • You're autonomous and always willing to lead projects and create new ones

  • You approach each project with humility, and aren't afraid to take risks

  • You're passionate about our mission of democratizing career growth to all!

  • You're great at and enjoy using emojis

  • Have experience with Motion design

  • Great sense of humor

Tablespace Games is proud to be an equal employment workplace committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
